title: How Close Is Local AI To ChatGPT? #shorts
description:
Two benchmarks: on coding (SWE-bench) the best desk-local model, Qwen 3.6 27B, scores 77 to ChatGPT 5.5's 88 — close. On agents (Terminal-Bench) the gap widens, 59 to 82. Free, private, on your desk.

Takeaway: CODING: NEARLY THERE. AGENTS: STILL A GAP. FREE. PRIVATE. LOCAL.

Grounded in real 2026 benchmarks (SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench) and build specs.
Full breakdown & the data: https://llmrequirements.com
